Multiply the correct area ratio 1/4 by the horizontal scale factor 1/2 once more.

At x=0 the vertical gap is 6; at x=1 it is 3. The triangle widths are 2 and 1.
Areas are $\frac12(6)(2)=6$ and $\frac12(3)(1)=3/2$. Their ratio is $1/4$.
